picks._method: The 17 Sep playbook's rule, applied to the whole season instead of one quarter.
picks._na_premium_note: 83.9M vs 35.2M Kalshi median. A TIEBREAKER, not a law - the cohort is confounded with Kalshi's 11 July launch.
picks._confidence_note: Every Challenger pick is [E] none: no individual Challenger has settled history on either venue. The ranking is a prior, not a measurement.
picks._no_clash_penalty: Deliberately absent. The 17 Sep playbook ran a Challenger in slot 1 every week regardless of what else was on - Shanghai week 2, Paris Masters, both Finals - and the 175s are scheduled alongside Masters events on purpose, which is where their fields come from.

_window_note: fetch_start is deliberately earlier than window_start: the 2027 projection is built by shifting the WHOLE 2026 season forward 364 days, so the full season has to be pulled even though only part of it is displayed. Without this, 2027 would have no Australian Open, no Wimbledon and no US Open.
_city_aliases_note: The two sources name the same place differently - the WTA calls Wimbledon 'Wimbledon' and ESPN calls it 'London'. Merging is by host city and ISO week, so an unaliased pair lists the tournament twice.
_main_draw_offset_note: Measured, not assumed: the median gap between ESPN's event date and the first main-draw match across the 2026 events that carry both. Only used when qualifying is on the board but the main draw is not yet timed - if there are no qualifying rows at all, ESPN's event date is already the main-draw Monday and is used unchanged.
